player_prompt.intro:
I ni ce! Welcome to Lights Out! I bɛ na {size}x{size} lajɛ la dɔ.
Kɛlɛ i bɛ taga ni dɔ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ ma (a bɛ sɔrɔ dɔ 'O' la).
I ka taga dɔ kɔnɔ, a bɛ a tɔgɔ dɔ la, n' a bɛ a kɛnɛ dɔ la wɛrɛ wɛrɛ (kɔrɔn/kɔrɔn tɛ/kɔrɔn bɛ/kɔrɔn bɛ).
Sɔrɔ [row col] ka taga dɔ kɔnɔ (0-kɛmɛ, o bɛ sɔrɔ 0-{max_index}).
I bɛ na {max_turns} kɛlɛ ka dɔ wɛrɛ wɛrɛ.
Kɛlɛ: 'O' = dɔ wɛrɛ, '.' = dɔ tɛ

board.current_state:
ɲɛfɛn ɲɛma kɔnɔ (Kɛlɛ {moves_made}, {moves_left} kɛlɛw sɔrɔ, {completion}% kɛlɛ):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Actions ka kan ka kɛ [row col] cogo la, yɔrɔ min na row ni col bɛ intɛgeriw ye 0 fo {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɔɔrdineeti bɛɛ kɔlɔsɔ 0 ni {max_index} cɛma. I bɛnna kɛlɛ [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Congratulations! I ye gundo laɲini {moves_used} na.
